outcome: Deliver replacement package 2 of the accepted 2026-08-29 reader topology: read-only owner-scoped account-export readers for the Capture and Moment domains (dbo.captures, dbo.capture_revisions, dbo.moments, dbo.moment_versions, dbo.moment_sources, dbo.moment_placements) as one additive migration PS-SETTINGS-EXPORT-004 with rollback, a registry entry whose requires covers both the readers' and the verification's dependencies, an isolation verification with constraint-complete fixtures, offline allowlist-pinning tests with a forbidden-field canary, DOMAINS registry updates, and contract records. Media transcripts, content hashes, binary and blob references, and media-source linkage columns are excluded from every allowlist in this package; text truth only. Procedures accept only a trusted server-derived user key, order deterministically, exclude soft-deleted rows, and never select internal ids or another member's data. No UI, worker, or integration change; no real export run; no schema apply outside the disposable gate; no production authority.
